## R Markdown

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Combined Land + Marine Aquaculture Species Summary for Manuscript
# =============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(here)
library(writexl)  # install.packages("writexl") if needed

# State name to abbreviation mapping
state_abbrev <- c(
  "Queensland" = "QLD", "New_South_Wales" = "NSW", "New South Wales" = "NSW",
  "South_Australia" = "SA", "South Australia" = "SA",
  "Western_Australia" = "WA", "Western Australia" = "WA",
  "Tasmania" = "TAS", "Northern_Territory" = "NT", "Northern Territory" = "NT",
  "Victoria" = "VIC",
  # Pass through if already abbreviated
  "QLD" = "QLD", "NSW" = "NSW", "SA" = "SA", "WA" = "WA",
  "TAS" = "TAS", "NT" = "NT", "VIC" = "VIC"
)
# --- 1. Load LAND-BASED data -------------------------------------------------

message("=== Loading land-based data ===")
land_sf <- st_read(here("output_data", "Land_Aquaculture_Vectors",
                        "Australia_Land_Aquaculture_National.shp"))



land_sf <- land_sf %>%
  mutate(
    pond_area_km2 = In_A_KM,
    species_display = case_when(
      !is.na(Spcs_cs) & Spcs_cs != "" & grepl("Multiple", Spcs_cs, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Multiple species",
      !is.na(Spcs_cs) & Spcs_cs != "" ~ Spcs_cs,
      TRUE ~ "Unknown species"
    ),
    is_hatchery = grepl("hatchery|hatcheries", Infr_ty, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )

message(paste("  Land sites loaded:", nrow(land_sf)))
```

#upload other marine leases to find the custodian id later
```{r}
# Read the original custodian marine lease files
raw_nsw <- st_read(here("raw_data/NSW/NSW_aquaculture_leases_2025/Aquaculture_Leases.shp"), 
                   quiet = TRUE)
raw_sa  <- st_read(here("raw_data/SA/SA_AquacultureLeasesAndLicences_shp/AquacultureLeasesAndLicences_GDA2020.shp"), 
                   quiet = TRUE)
raw_tas <- st_read(here("raw_data/TAS/TAS_Aquaculture_leases/LIST_MARINE_LEASES_STATEWIDE/list_marine_leases_statewide.shp"), 
                   quiet = TRUE)
raw_vic <- st_read(here("raw_data/VIC/vic_aquaculture_features.shp"), 
                   quiet = TRUE)
raw_wa  <- st_read(here("raw_data/WA_Aquaculture_Sites/Aquaculture_Sites_DPIRD_001.shp"), 
                   quiet = TRUE)
raw_qld <- st_read(here("raw_data/QLD/QLD_leases_2024/QLD_all_leases_2024.shp"), 
                   quiet = TRUE)

# Print columns and first few rows of ID-like columns for each
purrr::walk(
  list(NSW = raw_nsw, SA = raw_sa, TAS = raw_tas, 
       VIC = raw_vic, WA = raw_wa, QLD = raw_qld),
  function(x) {
    cat(sprintf("\n── %d rows, %d cols ──\n", nrow(x), ncol(x)))
    print(names(x))
  }
)
```


```{r}

purrr::iwalk(
  list(
    NSW = raw_nsw, 
    SA  = raw_sa, 
    TAS = raw_tas, 
    VIC = raw_vic, 
    WA  = raw_wa, 
    QLD = raw_qld
  ),
  function(x, state) {
    cat(sprintf("\n── %s (%d rows, %d cols) ──\n", state, nrow(x), ncol(x)))
    cat("Columns:\n")
    print(names(x))
    cat("First few rows of potential ID columns:\n")
    x %>% 
      st_drop_geometry() %>% 
      select(where(is.character)) %>% 
      head(3) %>% 
      print()
  }
)
```

#load marine data 

```{r}
# --- 2. Load MARINE data -----------------------------------------------------

message("\n=== Loading marine data ===")

marine_leases_sf <- st_read(here("output_data", "all_marine_leases_with_status.shp"))
message(paste("  Marine leases loaded:", nrow(marine_leases_sf)))
print(names(marine_leases_sf))

# Load AU_marine_leases separately (richer version with are_km2)
AU_marine_leases <- st_read(
  here("output_data/marine_leases_status_results/all_marine_leases_with_status.shp")) %>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577") %>%
  st_make_valid()%>%
  mutate(stat_ls = recode(stat_ls, !!!state_abbrev)) 

marine_infra_national <- read.csv(
  here("output_data", "infrastructure_by_species", "national_species_totals.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

marine_infra_by_state <- read.csv(
  here("output_data", "infrastructure_by_species", "state_species_totals.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(state_lease = recode(state_lease, !!!state_abbrev))

message(paste("  Marine infrastructure species totals loaded:", nrow(marine_infra_national)))
# --- 2b. Exclude Pearl Oysters (non-food) and NT marine leases ---------------

message("\n=== Excluding Pearl Oysters (non-food) ===")

pearl_removed_leases <- AU_marine_leases %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(grepl("pearl", Spcs_st, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), area_km2 = round(sum(are_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3))

pearl_removed_infra <- marine_infra_national %>%
  filter(grepl("pearl", Species_standardized, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), area_km2 = round(sum(total_infra_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3))

cat(sprintf(
  "Removing %d pearl leases (%.3f km²) and %d pearl infra records (%.3f km²)\n",
  pearl_removed_leases$n, pearl_removed_leases$area_km2,
  pearl_removed_infra$n,  pearl_removed_infra$area_km2
))

AU_marine_leases <- AU_marine_leases %>%
  filter(!grepl("pearl", Spcs_st, ignore.case = TRUE))

marine_leases_sf <- marine_leases_sf %>%
  filter(!grepl("pearl", Spcs_st, ignore.case = TRUE))

marine_infra_national <- marine_infra_national %>%
  filter(!grepl("pearl", Species_standardized, ignore.case = TRUE))

marine_infra_by_state <- marine_infra_by_state %>%
  filter(!grepl("pearl", Species_standardized, ignore.case = TRUE))

# ── Remove NT marine leases (land-only state) ─────────────────────────────────
message("\n=== Removing NT marine leases ===")
message(sprintf("  Removing %d NT leases (%.2f km²)",
  sum(AU_marine_leases$stat_ls == "NT"),
  sum(AU_marine_leases$are_km2[AU_marine_leases$stat_ls == "NT"])))

AU_marine_leases <- AU_marine_leases %>% filter(stat_ls != "NT")
marine_leases_sf <- marine_leases_sf %>% filter(stat_ls != "NT")

message(sprintf(
  "  marine_leases_sf: %d remaining\n  AU_marine_leases: %d remaining\n  marine_infra_national: %d rows remaining",
  nrow(marine_leases_sf), nrow(AU_marine_leases), nrow(marine_infra_national)
))

# --- 2c. Recover custodian IDs from raw state files via spatial join ----------

message("\n=== Recovering marine custodian IDs from raw state files ===")

# ── Read and standardise each state — filter to marine where possible ─────────
raw_nsw_m <- raw_nsw %>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577") %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(custodian_id = as.character(Lease_No), state_src = "NSW") %>%
  select(custodian_id, state_src, geometry)

raw_sa_m <- raw_sa %>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577") %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  filter(land_based == 0 | is.na(land_based)) %>%  # keep marine only
  mutate(custodian_id = as.character(reg_no), state_src = "SA") %>%
  select(custodian_id, state_src, geometry)

raw_tas_m <- raw_tas %>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577") %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(custodian_id = as.character(M_LEASE_NO), state_src = "TAS") %>%
  select(custodian_id, state_src, geometry)

raw_vic_m <- raw_vic %>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577") %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(custodian_id = as.character(NAME), state_src = "VIC") %>%
  select(custodian_id, state_src, geometry)

raw_wa_m <- raw_wa %>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577") %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  filter(grepl("marine|aqua|sea", site_typ, ignore.case = TRUE) | is.na(site_typ)) %>%
  mutate(custodian_id = as.character(aqua_id), state_src = "WA") %>%
  select(custodian_id, state_src, geometry)

raw_qld_m <- raw_qld %>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577") %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(custodian_id = as.character(qldglb_), state_src = "QLD") %>%
  select(custodian_id, state_src, geometry)

# Bind all raw state marine files
raw_marine_all <- bind_rows(
  raw_nsw_m, raw_sa_m, raw_tas_m,
  raw_vic_m, raw_wa_m, raw_qld_m
) %>%
  st_make_valid()

message(sprintf("  Raw marine features for joining: %d", nrow(raw_marine_all)))

# ── Spatial join: nearest feature match ───────────────────────────────────────
# Use largest overlap rather than nearest to avoid cross-state matches
# --- 2c. Recover custodian IDs -----------------------------------------------

# ... all raw_nsw_m, raw_sa_m etc. code unchanged ...

AU_marine_leases_cust <- AU_marine_leases %>%
  st_join(
    raw_marine_all %>% select(custodian_id, state_src),
    join = st_nearest_feature,
    left = TRUE
  )

recovered <- sum(!is.na(AU_marine_leases_cust$custodian_id))
cat(sprintf("Custodian ID recovered for %d of %d marine leases (%.1f%%)\n",
    recovered, nrow(AU_marine_leases),
    recovered / nrow(AU_marine_leases) * 100))

dupes <- sum(duplicated(AU_marine_leases_cust$lease_d))
cat(sprintf("Duplicate lease_d after join: %d\n", dupes))
if (dupes > 0) {
  AU_marine_leases_cust <- AU_marine_leases_cust %>%
    group_by(lease_d) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()
}

# ── Update AU_marine_leases ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
AU_marine_leases <- AU_marine_leases_cust

message("  AU_marine_leases updated with custodian_id")
AU_marine_leases %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(lease_d, stat_ls, custodian_id, state_src) %>%
  head(10) %>% print()


# --- 3. Summarise LAND-BASED data --------------------------------------------

message("\n=== Summarising land-based data ===")

# Active sites with ponds only
land_active <- land_sf %>%
  filter(Infr_st == "active", pond_area_km2 > 0)

# National totals
land_national <- land_active %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(species_display) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sites      = n(),
    land_area_km2 = round(sum(pond_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    n_hatcheries = sum(is_hatchery, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(land_area_km2))

# By state
land_by_state <- land_active %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(species_display, State) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sites      = n(),
    land_area_km2 = round(sum(pond_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(species_display, desc(land_area_km2))

message("  Land national summary:")
print(land_national, n = 20)

# --- 4. Summarise MARINE data ------------------------------------------------

message("\n=== Summarising marine data ===")

# Marine lease areas by species (all leases, not just detected)
# Need to handle truncated shapefile column names
# The Species_standardized column may be truncated to Spcs_st or similar
# Check and adapt:
marine_species_col <- "Spcs_st"
marine_state_col <- "stat_ls"

if (length(marine_species_col) == 0) {
  # Try to find it
  message("  WARNING: Could not auto-detect Species_standardized column.")
  message("  Available columns:")
  print(names(marine_leases_sf))
  message("  >>> UPDATE marine_species_col below manually <<<")
  marine_species_col <- "Spcs_st"  # Common truncation - UPDATE IF NEEDED
}
marine_species_col <- marine_species_col[1]
message(paste("  Using marine species column:", marine_species_col))

# Calculate lease area
marine_leases_sf <- marine_leases_sf %>%
  mutate(lease_area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6)

marine_leases_sf <- marine_leases_sf %>%
  mutate(stat_ls = recode(stat_ls, !!!state_abbrev))

# Marine lease area by species (national)
marine_lease_national <- marine_leases_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(species = .data[[marine_species_col]]) %>%
  summarise(
    n_leases          = n(),
    lease_area_km2    = round(sum(lease_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(lease_area_km2))

# Marine lease area by species and state
marine_lease_by_state <- marine_leases_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(species = .data[[marine_species_col]], 
           state = .data[[marine_state_col]]) %>%
  summarise(
    n_leases       = n(),
    lease_area_km2 = round(sum(lease_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(species, desc(lease_area_km2))

message("\n  Marine lease area by species (national):")
print(marine_lease_national, n = 20)

message("\n  Marine detected infrastructure by species (national):")
print(marine_infra_national, n = 20)

# --- 4b. Area by active/inactive status (lease + infrastructure) --------------

message("\n=== Area by active/inactive status ===")

# ── Land: all sites (not just those with ponds > 0) ──────────────────────────
land_area_status <- land_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Infr_st) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sites          = n(),
    lease_area_km2   = round(sum(Ls_A_KM,  na.rm = TRUE), 3),  # total site/lease area
    infra_area_km2   = round(sum(In_A_KM,  na.rm = TRUE), 3),  # detected pond area
    .groups = "drop"
  )

message("  Land area by status:")
print(land_area_status)

# Scalar values for inline text reporting
land_active_n_all       <- land_area_status %>% filter(Infr_st == "active")   %>% pull(n_sites)
land_inactive_n         <- land_area_status %>% filter(Infr_st == "inactive") %>% pull(n_sites)
land_active_lease_km2   <- land_area_status %>% filter(Infr_st == "active")   %>% pull(lease_area_km2)
land_inactive_lease_km2 <- land_area_status %>% filter(Infr_st == "inactive") %>% pull(lease_area_km2)
land_active_infra_km2   <- land_area_status %>% filter(Infr_st == "active")   %>% pull(infra_area_km2)

cat(sprintf(
  "\nLand active   (%d sites): lease area = %.2f km², detected pond area = %.2f km²\n",
  land_active_n_all, land_active_lease_km2, land_active_infra_km2
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Land inactive (%d sites): lease area = %.2f km² (no ponds detected)\n",
  land_inactive_n, land_inactive_lease_km2
))

# ── Marine: by detection status ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# lease_area_km2 was already computed from geometry at line 144
marine_area_status <- marine_leases_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(hs_dtct, stts_lb) %>%
  summarise(
    n_leases       = n(),
    lease_area_km2 = round(sum(lease_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(hs_dtct))

message("\n  Marine area by detection status:")
print(marine_area_status)

marine_present_n     <- marine_area_status %>% filter(hs_dtct == 1) %>% pull(n_leases)
marine_absent_n      <- marine_area_status %>% filter(hs_dtct == 0) %>% pull(n_leases)
marine_present_km2   <- marine_area_status %>% filter(hs_dtct == 1) %>% pull(lease_area_km2)
marine_absent_km2    <- marine_area_status %>% filter(hs_dtct == 0) %>% pull(lease_area_km2)

cat(sprintf(
  "\nMarine infrastructure detected (%d leases): lease area = %.2f km²\n",
  marine_present_n, marine_present_km2
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Marine no infrastructure detected (%d leases): lease area = %.2f km²\n",
  marine_absent_n, marine_absent_km2
))

# ── Combined summary table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
area_status_summary <- tibble(
  Sector = c("Land-based", "Land-based", "Marine", "Marine"),
  Status = c("Active", "Inactive",
             "Infrastructure detected", "No infrastructure detected"),
  N      = c(land_active_n_all, land_inactive_n,
             marine_present_n,  marine_absent_n),
  Lease_area_km2 = c(land_active_lease_km2, land_inactive_lease_km2,
                     marine_present_km2,    marine_absent_km2),
  # Land only: detected infrastructure footprint within the lease
  Detected_infra_km2 = c(land_active_infra_km2, 0, NA, NA)
)

message("\n  Combined area-by-status summary:")
print(area_status_summary)

# --- 4c. Marine area summary for results text --------------------------------


# Use AU_marine_leases which has the original are_km2 column
marine_area_status <- AU_marine_leases %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Infr_st) %>%
  summarise(
    n_leases       = n(),
    lease_area_km2 = round(sum(are_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

total_marine_n         <- sum(marine_area_status$n_leases)
total_marine_lease_km2 <- round(sum(marine_area_status$lease_area_km2), 3)

active_marine_n         <- marine_area_status %>% filter(Infr_st == "present") %>% pull(n_leases)
active_marine_lease_km2 <- marine_area_status %>% filter(Infr_st == "present") %>% pull(lease_area_km2)

active_marine_pct_n    <- round(active_marine_n / total_marine_n * 100, 1)
active_marine_pct_area <- round(active_marine_lease_km2 / total_marine_lease_km2 * 100, 1)

# ── Infrastructure footprint totals (from national species CSV) ───────────────
total_infra_km2        <- round(sum(marine_infra_national$total_infra_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
infra_pct_total_lease  <- round(total_infra_km2 / total_marine_lease_km2 * 100, 2)
infra_pct_active_lease <- round(total_infra_km2 / active_marine_lease_km2 * 100, 2)

# ── Infrastructure by type: longlines vs cages (from SSRG detection files) ───
ssrg_longlines <- st_read(here("output_data/SSRG_GEE_results/SSRG_shellfish_longlines_marine.shp")) %>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577") %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(infra_area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6)

ssrg_cages <- st_read(here("output_data/SSRG_GEE_results/SSRG_finfish_cages_marine.shp")) %>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577") %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(infra_area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6)

longline_km2 <- round(sum(ssrg_longlines$infra_area_km2), 3)
cage_km2     <- round(sum(ssrg_cages$infra_area_km2), 3)
type_total   <- round(longline_km2 + cage_km2, 3)
longline_pct <- round(longline_km2 / type_total * 100, 1)
cage_pct     <- round(cage_km2     / type_total * 100, 1)

# Sanity check: type_total should be close to total_infra_km2
cat(sprintf("Type total: %.3f km² | CSV total: %.3f km² | Difference: %.4f km²\n",
            type_total, total_infra_km2, abs(type_total - total_infra_km2)))

# ── Species attribution ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
assigned_km2   <- marine_infra_national %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species_standardized) & Species_standardized != "") %>%
  summarise(km2 = round(sum(total_infra_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3)) %>% pull(km2)

unassigned_km2 <- round(total_infra_km2 - assigned_km2, 3)
assigned_pct   <- round(assigned_km2   / total_infra_km2 * 100, 1)
unassigned_pct <- round(unassigned_km2 / total_infra_km2 * 100, 1)

# ── Print results text ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat(sprintf(
"Nationally, marine leases covered %.1f km². We classified %.1f%% (%d of %d) of marine
leases as active, covering %.1f km² (%.1f%% of total marine lease area). Marine aquaculture
infrastructure footprint was %.3f km², representing %.2f%% of the total licensed marine
lease area (%.1f km²) and %.2f%% of the active lease area (%.1f km²). This footprint was
dominated by longline systems (%.2f km²; %.1f%%), with cages accounting for %.2f km²
(%.1f%%). Species attribution was possible for %.1f%% of the infrastructure area (%.3f km²),
while %.1f%% (%.3f km²) remained unassigned.\n",
  total_marine_lease_km2,
  active_marine_pct_n, active_marine_n, total_marine_n,
  active_marine_lease_km2, active_marine_pct_area,
  total_infra_km2,
  infra_pct_total_lease, total_marine_lease_km2,
  infra_pct_active_lease, active_marine_lease_km2,
  longline_km2, longline_pct,
  cage_km2, cage_pct,
  assigned_pct, assigned_km2,
  unassigned_pct, unassigned_km2
))

# --- 4d. Inactive sites by state: expansion potential ------------------------
# Safety filter — ensure NT is excluded regardless of upstream state
AU_marine_leases <- AU_marine_leases %>% filter(stat_ls != "NT")
marine_leases_sf  <- marine_leases_sf  %>% filter(stat_ls != "NT")

# ── Land-based inactive sites by state ───────────────────────────────────────
land_inactive_by_state <- land_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(Infr_st == "inactive") %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  summarise(
    n_inactive_sites  = n(),
    inactive_lease_km2 = round(sum(Ls_A_KM, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(inactive_lease_km2))   

# Active for context
land_active_by_state <- land_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(Infr_st == "active") %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  summarise(
    n_active_sites   = n(),
    active_lease_km2 = round(sum(Ls_A_KM, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    active_infra_km2 = round(sum(In_A_KM, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

land_by_state_full <- land_active_by_state %>%
  full_join(land_inactive_by_state, by = "State") %>%
  mutate(
    total_sites          = coalesce(n_active_sites, 0L) + coalesce(n_inactive_sites, 0L),
    inactive_pct_sites   = round(coalesce(n_inactive_sites, 0L) / total_sites * 100, 1),
    inactive_pct_area    = round(coalesce(inactive_lease_km2, 0) /
                           (coalesce(active_lease_km2, 0) + coalesce(inactive_lease_km2, 0)) * 100, 1)
   ) %>%
  arrange(desc(inactive_lease_km2))

message("  Land inactive sites by state (sorted by inactive lease area):")
print(land_by_state_full, n = 20)

# ── Marine inactive leases by state ──────────────────────────────────────────
marine_inactive_by_state <- AU_marine_leases %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(Infr_st == "absent") %>%
  group_by(stat_ls) %>%
  summarise(
    n_inactive_leases = n(),
    inactive_area_km2 = round(sum(are_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),  # renamed
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(inactive_area_km2))

marine_active_by_state <- AU_marine_leases %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(Infr_st == "present") %>%
  group_by(stat_ls) %>%
  summarise(
    n_active_leases  = n(),
    active_area_km2  = round(sum(are_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),   # renamed
    .groups = "drop"
  )

marine_by_state_full <- marine_active_by_state %>%
  full_join(marine_inactive_by_state, by = "stat_ls") %>%
  mutate(
    total_leases        = coalesce(n_active_leases,  0L) + coalesce(n_inactive_leases, 0L),
    total_area_km2      = round(coalesce(active_area_km2, 0) + coalesce(inactive_area_km2, 0), 3),
    inactive_pct_leases = round(coalesce(n_inactive_leases, 0L) / total_leases * 100, 1),
    inactive_pct_area   = round(coalesce(inactive_area_km2, 0) / total_area_km2 * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(inactive_area_km2)) %>%
  rename(State = stat_ls)

cat("\n── TOP STATES: inactive marine lease area ──\n")
marine_by_state_full %>%
  select(State, n_inactive_leases, inactive_area_km2, inactive_pct_leases) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  print()

cat("\n── TOP STATES: inactive land-based lease area ──\n")
land_by_state_full %>%
  select(State, n_inactive_sites, lease_area_km2, inactive_pct_sites) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  print()

# --- 5. Build state detail strings --------------------------------------------

# Land states string
land_states_str <- land_by_state %>%
  group_by(species_display) %>%
  summarise(
    land_states_detail = paste0(State, " (", land_area_km2, " km2)", collapse = ", "),
    land_states_list   = paste0(sort(unique(State)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Marine infrastructure states string (from CSV)
marine_infra_states_str <- marine_infra_by_state %>%
  group_by(Species_standardized) %>%
  summarise(
    marine_infra_states_detail = paste0(state_lease, " (", total_infra_km2, " km2)", collapse = ", "),
    marine_infra_states_list   = paste0(sort(unique(state_lease)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Marine lease states string
# Clean state names (remove underscores)
marine_lease_states_str <- marine_lease_by_state %>%
  mutate(state_clean = str_replace_all(state, "_", " ")) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    marine_lease_states_detail = paste0(state_clean, " (", lease_area_km2, " km2)", collapse = ", "),
    marine_lease_states_list   = paste0(sort(unique(state_clean)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 6. ABARES Production Data (2021-22) -------------------------------------

abares_production <- tribble(
  ~species_manuscript,          ~production_aud, ~production_tonnes,
  "Southern Bluefin Tuna",      110400,          8322,
  "Other finfish (marine)",     NA,              NA,
  "Oysters",                    149671,          11735,
  "Mussels",                    4984,            2173,
  "Abalone",                    26285,           689,
  "Yabbies",                    752,             21,
  "Marron",                     4511,            113,
  "Cherax spp.",                NA,              NA,
  "Red claw",                   850,             31,
  "Prawns",                     180821,          9450,
  "Barramundi",                 60572,           4741,
  "Salmon",                     1149408,         79271,
  "Native finfish (land)",      NA,              NA,
  "Murray Cod",                 NA,              NA,
  "Lobster",                    NA,              NA,
  "Unknown (land-based)",       NA,              NA,
  "Hatcheries (land-based)",    NA,              NA,
  "Multiple species (land)",    NA,              NA,
  "Aquarium",                   NA,              NA,
  "Rainbow Trout",              NA,              NA
)

# --- 7. Species mapping: LAND ------------------------------------------------
# Maps land species_display names to manuscript names

land_species_mapping <- tribble(
  ~species_display,       ~species_manuscript,
  "Prawn",                "Prawns",
  "Cherax spp.",          "Cherax spp.",
  "Unknown species",      "Unknown (land-based)",
  "Barramundi",           "Barramundi",
  "Red Claw Crayfish",    "Red claw",
  "Native finfish",       "Native finfish (land)",
  "Hatchery",             "Hatcheries (land-based)",
  "Multiple species",     "Multiple species (land)",
  "Abalone",              "Abalone",
  "Murray Cod",           "Murray Cod",
  "aquarium",             "Aquarium",
  "Salmon",               "Salmon",
  "Yabby",                "Yabbies",
  "Rainbow Trout",        "Rainbow Trout",
  "lobster",              "Lobster"
)

# --- 8. Species mapping: MARINE ----------------------------------------------
# Maps marine Species_standardized names to manuscript names
# >>> You may need to adjust the left column based on your actual values <<<

marine_species_mapping <- tribble(
  ~marine_species,                              ~species_manuscript,
  "Edible Oyster (aggregated)",                 "Oysters",
  "Pearl Oyster (non-food)",                    "Pearl Oyster (non-food)",
  "Mussel (aggregated)",                        "Mussels",
  "Blue Mussel",                                "Mussels",
  "Atlantic Salmon",                            "Salmon",
  "Southern Bluefin Tuna (aggregated)",         "Southern Bluefin Tuna",
  "Southern Bluefin Tuna or Yellowtail Kingfish", "Southern Bluefin Tuna",
  "Yellowtail Kingfish",                        "Other finfish (Kingfish)",
  "Finfish",                                    "Other finfish (marine)",
  "Barramundi (Cone Bay - Marine)",             "Barramundi",
  "Pacific Oyster",                             "Oysters",
  "Pacific Oyster or Blue Mussel",              "Oysters",
  "Sydney Rock Oyster (predominant)",           "Oysters",
  "Edible Oyster (Albany/Oyster Harbour)",       "Oysters",
  "Pearl Oyster or Rock Oyster",                "Pearl Oyster (non-food)",
  "Abalone",                                    "Abalone",
  "Greenlip Abalone",                           "Abalone",
  "Blacklip Abalone",                           "Abalone",
  "Sea Cucumber",                               "Sea Cucumber",
  "Lobster",                                    "Lobster"
)

# --- 9. Print unique marine species to verify mapping ------------------------

message("\n=== MARINE Species_standardized values (verify mapping) ===")
marine_species_unique <- marine_infra_national %>%
  select(Species_standardized) %>%
  arrange(Species_standardized)
print(marine_species_unique, n = 30)

message("\n=== MARINE lease species values ===")
print(sort(unique(marine_lease_national$species)))

# --- 10. Build the combined manuscript table ----------------------------------

message("\n=== BUILDING COMBINED MANUSCRIPT TABLE ===")

# A) Land infrastructure (ponds/tanks)
land_for_table <- land_national %>%
  left_join(land_species_mapping, by = "species_display") %>%
  left_join(land_states_str, by = "species_display") %>%
  filter(!is.na(species_manuscript)) %>%
  select(species_manuscript,
         land_n_sites     = n_sites,
         land_infra_km2   = land_area_km2,
         land_states_detail,
         land_states_list)

# B) Marine infrastructure (cages/longlines - DETECTED by SSRG)
marine_infra_for_table <- marine_infra_national %>%
  left_join(marine_species_mapping, 
            by = c("Species_standardized" = "marine_species")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(species_manuscript)) %>%
  group_by(species_manuscript) %>%
  summarise(
    marine_infra_n     = sum(n_detections, na.rm = TRUE),
    marine_infra_km2   = round(sum(total_infra_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Marine infrastructure states with area detail
marine_infra_states_mapped <- marine_infra_by_state %>%
  left_join(marine_species_mapping, 
            by = c("Species_standardized" = "marine_species")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(species_manuscript)) %>%
  mutate(state_clean = str_replace_all(state_lease, "_", " ")) %>%
  group_by(species_manuscript, state_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    total_infra_km2 = round(sum(total_infra_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(species_manuscript) %>%
  summarise(
    marine_infra_states_detail = paste0(state_clean, " (", total_infra_km2, " km2)", collapse = ", "),
    marine_infra_states_list   = paste0(sort(unique(state_clean)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

marine_infra_for_table <- marine_infra_for_table %>%
  left_join(marine_infra_states_mapped, by = "species_manuscript")

# C) Marine lease area (official lease footprint - contextual)
marine_lease_for_table <- marine_lease_national %>%
  left_join(marine_species_mapping, 
            by = c("species" = "marine_species")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(species_manuscript)) %>%
  group_by(species_manuscript) %>%
  summarise(
    marine_lease_n      = sum(n_leases, na.rm = TRUE),
    marine_lease_km2    = round(sum(lease_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# D) Combine: infrastructure area is PRIMARY, lease area is CONTEXTUAL
manuscript_table <- abares_production %>%
  left_join(land_for_table, by = "species_manuscript") %>%
  left_join(marine_infra_for_table, by = "species_manuscript") %>%
  left_join(marine_lease_for_table, by = "species_manuscript") %>%
  mutate(
    # Infrastructure type indicator
    infra_type = case_when(
      !is.na(land_infra_km2) & !is.na(marine_infra_km2) ~ "Land + Marine",
      !is.na(land_infra_km2)  ~ "Land-based",
      !is.na(marine_infra_km2) ~ "Marine",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    
    # TOTAL infrastructure area (ponds + cages/longlines) - KEY METRIC
    total_infra_km2 = round(
      coalesce(land_infra_km2, 0) + coalesce(marine_infra_km2, 0), 3
    ),
    total_infra_km2 = if_else(total_infra_km2 == 0, NA_real_, total_infra_km2),
    
    # States detail combining land + marine with area breakdown
    states_detail = case_when(
      !is.na(land_states_detail) & !is.na(marine_infra_states_detail) ~
        paste0("Land: ", land_states_detail, " | Marine: ", marine_infra_states_detail),
      !is.na(land_states_detail) ~ land_states_detail,
      !is.na(marine_infra_states_detail) ~ marine_infra_states_detail,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # Simple states list (deduplicated)
    all_states_list = purrr::map2_chr(
      coalesce(land_states_list, ""),
      coalesce(marine_infra_states_list, ""),
      ~ {
        all <- unique(trimws(unlist(str_split(paste(.x, .y, sep = ", "), ","))))
        all <- all[all != ""]
        if (length(all) == 0) return(NA_character_)
        paste(sort(all), collapse = ", ")
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Species                      = species_manuscript,
    `Infra type`                 = infra_type,
    `Total infra area (km2)`     = total_infra_km2,
    `Land infra (km2)`           = land_infra_km2,
    `Marine infra (km2)`         = marine_infra_km2,
    `Lease area (km2)`           = marine_lease_km2,
    `Production 2021-22 (AUD)`   = production_aud,
    `Production 2021-22 (t)`     = production_tonnes,
    `States`                     = all_states_list,
    `States detail`              = states_detail
  )

message("\n=== COMBINED MANUSCRIPT TABLE ===\n")
manuscript_table <- manuscript_table %>%
  mutate(
    Notes = case_when(
      Species == "Cherax spp." ~ "Combined Yabbies + Marron (not distinguishable by satellite)",
      Species == "Yabbies"     ~ "Subset of Cherax spp. (ABARES only)",
      Species == "Marron"      ~ "Subset of Cherax spp. (ABARES only)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
print(manuscript_table, n = 30, width = 150)

# Also print a simplified version for quick reference
message("\n=== SIMPLIFIED VIEW (key columns) ===\n")
manuscript_table %>%
  select(Species, `Infra type`, `Total infra area (km2)`, 
         `Production 2021-22 (t)`, States) %>%
  print(n = 30)
```

```{r}
# ── Land-based lease area summary for results text ───────────────────────────

land_area_status <- land_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Infr_st) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sites        = n(),
    lease_area_km2 = round(sum(Ls_A_KM, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    infra_area_km2 = round(sum(In_A_KM, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Scalars
total_n           <- sum(land_area_status$n_sites)
total_lease_km2   <- round(sum(land_area_status$lease_area_km2), 3)

active_n          <- land_area_status %>% filter(Infr_st == "active") %>% pull(n_sites)
active_lease_km2  <- land_area_status %>% filter(Infr_st == "active") %>% pull(lease_area_km2)
active_infra_km2  <- land_area_status %>% filter(Infr_st == "active") %>% pull(infra_area_km2)

active_pct_n      <- round(active_n     / total_n          * 100, 1)
active_pct_area   <- round(active_lease_km2 / total_lease_km2 * 100, 1)
infra_pct_total   <- round(active_infra_km2 / total_lease_km2 * 100, 2)
infra_pct_active  <- round(active_infra_km2 / active_lease_km2 * 100, 2)

# --- Land-based results text (confirmed values) ------------------------------

cat(sprintf(
  "In total, there were 2,294.6 km² of area within terrestrial aquaculture leases
in Australia. Of these, %.1f%% (%d of %d) were classified as active, covering
1,764.8 km² (76.9%% of total lease area). The total infrastructure footprint
covered 27.09 km², representing 1.18%% of the total licensed land-based lease
area (2,294.6 km²) and 1.54%% of active lease area (1,764.8 km²).\n",
  active_pct_n, active_n, total_n
))
```

```{r}
# --- 12. Combined land + marine spatial dataset (GeoPackage) -----------------

# ── Land ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
land_combined <- land_sf %>%
  mutate(
    sector         = "Land-based",
    site_id        = as.character(SiteID),  # force to character
    custodian_id   = Cstd_ID,
    region         = LGA,
    group          = Taxon,
    status         = Infr_st,
    lease_area_km2 = Ls_A_KM,
    infra_area_km2 = In_A_KM,
    infra_type     = case_when(
      grepl("pond",     Infr_ty, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ponds",
      grepl("tank|ras", Infr_ty, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "tanks/RAS",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),
    species        = species_display,
    state          = State
  ) %>%
  select(sector, site_id, custodian_id, region, group,
         status, lease_area_km2, infra_area_km2,
         infra_type, species, state, geometry)

# ── Marine leases ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
marine_combined <- AU_marine_leases %>%
  mutate(
    sector         = "Marine",
    site_id        = lease_d,
    custodian_id   = custodian_id,   # recovered from raw state files in section 2c
    region         = region,
    group          = Group,
    status         = case_when(
      Infr_st == "present" ~ "active",
      Infr_st == "absent"  ~ "inactive",
      TRUE ~ Infr_st
    ),
    lease_area_km2 = are_km2,
    infra_area_km2 = NA_real_,
    infra_type     = NA_character_,
    species        = Spcs_st,
    state          = stat_ls
  ) %>%
  select(sector, site_id, custodian_id, region, group,
         status, lease_area_km2, infra_area_km2,
         infra_type, species, state, geometry)

# ── Marine infrastructure: longlines ─────────────────────────────────────────
ssrg_longlines_combined <- ssrg_longlines %>%
  mutate(
    sector         = "Marine",
    site_id        = NA_character_,
    custodian_id   = NA_character_,
    region         = NA_character_,
    group          = "Molluscs",
    status         = "active",
    lease_area_km2 = NA_real_,
    infra_area_km2 = infra_area_km2,
    infra_type     = "longline",
    species        = NA_character_,
    state          = State
  ) %>%
  select(sector, site_id, custodian_id, region, group,
         status, lease_area_km2, infra_area_km2,
         infra_type, species, state, geometry)

# ── Marine infrastructure: cages ─────────────────────────────────────────────
ssrg_cages_combined <- ssrg_cages %>%
  mutate(
    sector         = "Marine",
    site_id        = NA_character_,
    custodian_id   = NA_character_,
    region         = NA_character_,
    group          = "Fish",
    status         = "active",
    lease_area_km2 = NA_real_,
    infra_area_km2 = infra_area_km2,
    infra_type     = "cage",
    species        = NA_character_,
    state          = State
  ) %>%
  select(sector, site_id, custodian_id, region, group,
         status, lease_area_km2, infra_area_km2,
         infra_type, species, state, geometry)

# ── Bind all layers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
AU_aquaculture_combined <- bind_rows(
  land_combined           %>% mutate(site_id = as.character(site_id)),
  marine_combined         %>% mutate(site_id = as.character(site_id)),
  ssrg_longlines_combined %>% mutate(site_id = as.character(site_id)),
  ssrg_cages_combined     %>% mutate(site_id = as.character(site_id))
) %>%
  st_make_valid()

message(sprintf(
  "Combined dataset: %d features\n  Land leases:   %d\n  Marine leases: %d\n  Longlines:     %d\n  Cages:         %d",
  nrow(AU_aquaculture_combined),
  nrow(land_combined),
  nrow(marine_combined),
  nrow(ssrg_longlines_combined),
  nrow(ssrg_cages_combined)
))

# ── Sanity check ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
AU_aquaculture_combined %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(sector, status, infra_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    lease_area_km2 = round(sum(lease_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    infra_area_km2 = round(sum(infra_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print(n = 20)

# ── Save as GeoPackage (full column names preserved) ─────────────────────────
gpkg_path <- here("output_data", "summaries", "AU_aquaculture_combined.gpkg")

st_write(AU_aquaculture_combined,
         dsn        = gpkg_path,
         layer      = "AU_aquaculture_combined",
         delete_dsn = TRUE)

message("  Saved: ", gpkg_path)
message("  Column names fully preserved — ready for Shiny app")

```
